findings.title: NPE fix is incomplete — sibling methods still dereference null
findings.body: In file model/infinispan/src/main/java/org/keycloak/models/cache/infinispan/GroupAdapter.java at line 274 getSubGroupsCount() was changed to null-check modelSupplier.get() because the group can be concurrently deleted and getGroupById() returns null. The same race exists in the three getSubGroupsStream() overloads on lines 256, 262, 268 which unconditionally do modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...). A concurrent delete between caching and that call will still throw NullPointerException, so the reported issue Closes #40368 is only partially fixed and listing groups with brief representation can still fail with 500.

findings.title: Concurrent test thread is never joined, making test flaky and leaky
findings.body: In file tests/base/src/test/java/org/keycloak/tests/admin/group/GroupTest.java at line 139 the new test createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti starts a raw new Thread() to read groups while the main thread deletes them, then sets deletedAll and immediately asserts caughtExceptions is empty without join(). The reader may never run before deletes finish so the test can pass vacuously, the assertion can race with an in-flight request, and the thread keeps running after the test ends and can interfere with subsequent tests using the same realm. The thread handle should be stored and join()ed with a timeout before asserting.
